run_qemu_rnd_helper.cmd: QH_LOG=/tmp/qemu-rnd-helper.log; QH_RC=/tmp/qemu-rnd-helper.rc; rm -f "$QH_RC"; echo "AUTOPILOT_INFO: QEMU_RND_HELPER_START"; ( qemu-rnd-helper >"$QH_LOG" 2>&1; rc=$?; echo "$rc" > "$QH_RC"; echo "AUTOPILOT_INFO: QEMU_RND_HELPER_EXIT_RC=$rc"; if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then echo "AUTOPILOT_FAIL: QEMU_RND_HELPER_EXIT_NONZERO rc=$rc"; tail -n 80 "$QH_LOG" | sed 's/^/AUTOPILOT_QEMU_ERR: /'; fi ) & qh_pid=$!; echo "AUTOPILOT_INFO: QEMU_RND_HELPER_LAUNCHED pid=$qh_pid log=$QH_LOG rc_file=$QH_RC"; sleep 1; if ! kill -0 "$qh_pid" 2>/dev/null; then if [ -f "$QH_RC" ]; then rc=$(cat "$QH_RC"); echo "AUTOPILOT_INFO: QEMU_RND_HELPER_EARLY_EXIT rc=$rc"; fi; fi

emit_qemu_bootstrap_diag.cmd:
echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: QEMU_BOOTSTRAP_DIAG_BEGIN'; qh_pid=''; for _ in $(seq 1 20); do qh_pid=$(pidof qemu-rnd-helper 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}'); if [ -n "$qh_pid" ]; then break; fi; sleep 1; done; if [ -n "$qh_pid" ]; then echo "AUTOPILOT_INFO: QEMU_RND_HELPER_RUNNING_AFTER_LAUNCH pid=$qh_pid"; if [ -r "/proc/$qh_pid/comm" ]; then printf 'AUTOPILOT_QEMU_PROC: pid=%s comm=%s
' "$qh_pid" "$(cat "/proc/$qh_pid/comm")"; fi; if [ -r "/proc/$qh_pid/cmdline" ]; then tr '\000' ' ' < "/proc/$qh_pid/cmdline" | sed "s/^/AUTOPILOT_QEMU_PROC: pid=$qh_pid cmdline=/"; fi; if [ -r "/proc/$qh_pid/maps" ]; then sed "s/^/AUTOPILOT_QEMU_MAP: pid=$qh_pid /" "/proc/$qh_pid/maps"; else echo "AUTOPILOT_QEMU_PROC: pid=$qh_pid maps_unreadable"; fi; else echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: QEMU_RND_HELPER_NOT_RUNNING_AFTER_LAUNCH'; echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: VM0_PROC_DIAG_BEGIN'; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do [ -d "$p" ] || continue; pid=${p#/proc/}; comm=$(cat "$p/comm" 2>/dev/null || true); printf 'AUTOPILOT_VM0_PROC: pid=%s comm=%s
' "$pid" "$comm"; if [ -r "$p/maps" ]; then sed "s/^/AUTOPILOT_VM0_MAP: pid=$pid /" "$p/maps"; fi; done; echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: VM0_PROC_DIAG_END'; fi; if [ -f /tmp/qemu-rnd-helper.rc ]; then echo "AUTOPILOT_INFO: QEMU_RND_HELPER_RC_EARLY=$(cat /tmp/qemu-rnd-helper.rc)"; fi; if [ -f /tmp/qemu-rnd-helper.log ]; then tail -n 60 /tmp/qemu-rnd-helper.log | sed 's/^/AUTOPILOT_QEMU_BOOTSTRAP: /'; else echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: QEMU_RND_HELPER_LOG_MISSING_AFTER_LAUNCH'; fi; echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: VM0_MODULE_DIAG_BEGIN'; if [ -r /proc/modules ]; then sed 's/^/AUTOPILOT_VM0_MODULE: /' /proc/modules; else echo 'AUTOPILOT_VM0_MODULE: /proc/modules unreadable'; fi; for d in /sys/module/*; do if [ -d "$d" ]; then mod=${d##*/}; if [ -r "$d/sections/.text" ]; then printf 'AUTOPILOT_VM0_MODULE_TEXT: %s .text=%s
' "$mod" "$(cat "$d/sections/.text")"; fi; if [ -r "$d/sections/.init.text" ]; then printf 'AUTOPILOT_VM0_MODULE_TEXT: %s .init.text=%s
' "$mod" "$(cat "$d/sections/.init.text")"; fi; fi; done; echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: VM0_MODULE_DIAG_END'; echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: QEMU_BOOTSTRAP_DIAG_END'

emit_dump_reason_hard_cap.cmd: echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: FTRACE_DUMP_REASON=HARD_CAP_120S_NO_RPC'; echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: NO_ACTIVITY_DIAG_BEGIN'; if [ -f /tmp/qemu-rnd-helper.rc ]; then rc=$(cat /tmp/qemu-rnd-helper.rc); echo "AUTOPILOT_INFO: QEMU_RND_HELPER_RC_FILE rc=$rc"; else echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: QEMU_RND_HELPER_RC_FILE missing'; fi; if pgrep -x qemu-rnd-helper >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: QEMU_RND_HELPER_STILL_RUNNING'; else echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: QEMU_RND_HELPER_NOT_RUNNING'; fi; if [ -f /tmp/qemu-rnd-helper.log ]; then tail -n 80 /tmp/qemu-rnd-helper.log | sed 's/^/AUTOPILOT_QEMU_LOG: /'; else echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: QEMU_RND_HELPER_LOG_MISSING_ON_TIMEOUT'; fi; echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: NO_ACTIVITY_DIAG_END'
